description: Karnataka's 2026-27 Budget includes AI education initiatives, a digital tutor for students, and a new robotics campus | India News
body_lead: Karnataka budget announces AI tutor for 1.2 million students Karnataka's 2026-27 Budget includes AI education initiatives, a digital tutor for students, and a new robotics campus The Karnataka government on Friday announced a series of initiatives to strengthen artificial intelligence education, research and technology infrastructure in the State while presenting the 2026–27 Budget.
